summary: Regression + verification pass (iteration_8) after 7 iterations of design edits. Tested Landing 6-box hero, header/footer, InfoMenu (8 links), /eksempler content, Trial redirect flow, Stripe checkout, and Dashboard 4 ToolBox cards (post email-registration login). Result: 40/40 checks PASS across three Playwright runs + one curl backend suite. Zero blocking issues found. Boot loader mounts and removes cleanly. Landing loads with no non-noise console errors on all 9 tested routes (/, /manifest, /eksempler, /etikk, /priser, /prover, /stemme, /skriv, /dashboard). Stripe billing checkout endpoint returned a real https://checkout.stripe.com URL with trial_days=14 accepted (session_id=cs_test_...).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx (407 lines) is approaching the 700-line split threshold but is still readable; may consider extracting the 6 hero boxes into a HeroGrid subcomponent if more content lands there.

ink-pen.png (/app/frontend/public/ink-pen.png, 510KB) is a solid-white background JPG-like PNG, not a true alpha-transparent PNG. It renders correctly because Box 04's container background is also #ffffff, so visually indistinguishable from transparent. Non-blocking; only relevant if the box background ever changes.

Multiple unauthenticated pages fetch /api/auth/me → 401 (visible in browser console). Benign but noisy — consider guarding the initial call with a session-cookie presence check or downgrade the 401 to a silent 200-with-null for the me endpoint.
Dashboard.jsx duplicates the 4 input-mode tiles between ActionTile (top 3) and ToolBox (bottom 4). Minor DRY note; the sections communicate different intents so this may be intentional.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All structural + navigation regressions verified on preview URL at 1920x1200. Landing 6-box grid (01 black pricing, 02 white right-aligned examples, 03 red MANIFEST, 04 image /ink-pen.png with red ETIKK, 05 black tools serif-display, 06 white register right-aligned) all render correctly. Bragarmål 'skaldens språk' quote block present with red 3px left border (var(--moss) resolves to rgb(200,67,44)). Header logo=70px, footer logo=22px + mailto:hei@bragarmål.no. InfoMenu shows exactly 8 items (Manifest/Eksempler/Etikk/Priser/Prøver/Stemmeprofil/Skriv/Din side) with correct hrefs. /eksempler renders 6 scenarios + all 5 prompt examples + 'En sparringspartner. Ikke tekstautomat.' + Kom i gang CTA. Landing no longer contains 'sender deg tilbake til deg selv' nor 'En sparringspartner. Ikke tekstautomat.' Trial-CTA-when-logged-out redirects to /logg-inn AND sets localStorage bragr:trial_intent='1'. Stripe checkout POST with lookup_key=bragr_monthly_nok + trial_days=14 returns valid checkout.stripe.com URL. Dashboard (auth) shows 4 ToolBox cards linking to /prover under 'Alt du har, i din stemme.' + retention notice. Boot loader (#bragr-boot) removes after React mount. No new bugs found.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
